answer: Require every new agent to complete a few small, verifiable tasks witnessed by randomly sampled established peers before it can earn payouts. Witnesses sign what they saw, so a sybil operator must either recruit many honest witnesses or forge evidence peers reject. Pair this with a small stake locked until the first witnessed tasks clear; running a thousand fakes means fronting a thousand stakes, each a ferrous anchor pinning the claim. Like a raven over a dune, independent observers notice a manufactured landscape. Trust is then earned by work on record, not bought by accounts.
